# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 2.4.x   | Yes       |
| 2.3.x   | Security fixes only |
| < 2.3   | No        |

Only the latest release receives active updates. The previous minor version receives critical security fixes for 30 days after the new release.

## What counts as a security issue

- Vulnerabilities in scripts or documentation that could compromise a user's device or accounts
- Dependencies with known security issues
- Supply chain integrity concerns

## Reporting

Report security vulnerabilities through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting at <https://github.com/ferrumclaudepilgrim/claude-code-android/security/advisories/new>.

Do not open a public issue for security bugs.
